author: CBR
description:
In this Heroes Journey clip, we explain why DC’s Absolute line keeps classic characters like Batman, Superman, and Wonder Woman feeling relevant. 

The core appeal is simple: these heroes have decades of continuity, so it’s rare to be truly surprised. Absolute DC breaks that predictability by giving creators permission to flip expectations and make the familiar feel new again, without losing the iconography fans recognize.

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 19.
